nodes.label: Document
nodes.desc: Backward-compat subclass of TextNode; what readers like SimpleDirectoryReader emit.

nodes.label: TextNode
nodes.desc: The unit of retrieval: text, metadata, start/end char indices and a hash over content.

nodes.label: NodeWithScore
nodes.desc: A node plus its similarity score; the currency handed from retrievers to synthesizers.

nodes.label: Ingestion flow
nodes.desc: The ingestion runner applies each transformation in order, batching documents into nodes.

nodes.label: IngestionCache
nodes.desc: Caches transformation output keyed on document hash so re-runs skip unchanged docs.

nodes.label: SentenceSplitter
nodes.desc: Splits on sentence boundaries while packing to a token budget (default 1024, overlap 20).

nodes.label: BaseEmbedding
nodes.desc: Abstract embedder: also acts as a TransformComponent, so it can run inside ingestion.

nodes.label: get_text_embedding
nodes.desc: Single-text entry point delegating to the provider _get_text_embedding hook.

nodes.label: get_text_embedding_batch
nodes.desc: Batches texts (default batch size 10) and requests embeddings for each chunk of the batch.

nodes.label: aget_text_embedding
nodes.desc: Async twin used by the async ingestion and retrieval paths.

nodes.label: BasePydanticVectorStore
nodes.desc: Contract every provider store implements: add, delete, query plus persistence.

nodes.label: VectorStoreQuery
nodes.desc: Carries query_embedding, similarity_top_k, mode and metadata filters to any store.

nodes.label: SimpleVectorStore
nodes.desc: Reference in-memory store: a dict of text_id to embedding vector.

nodes.label: SimpleVectorStore.add
nodes.desc: Extracts node embeddings and appends them to the in-memory dict.

nodes.label: SimpleVectorStore.query
nodes.desc: Computes similarity against every stored vector and returns the top_k results.

nodes.label: BaseIndex.from_documents
nodes.desc: The classic one-liner: run transformations over documents, then build the index.

nodes.label: VectorStoreIndex
nodes.desc: Default index for any stores_text=True vector store; keeps only an index struct, not the nodes.

nodes.label: build_index_from_nodes
nodes.desc: Feeds nodes into the async or sync add path and persists the index struct.

nodes.label: _add_nodes_to_index
nodes.desc: Batch-embeds nodes without embeddings, then pushes them into the vector store.

nodes.label: as_retriever
nodes.desc: Factory that binds the index to a VectorIndexRetriever with a chosen top_k.

nodes.label: BaseRetriever
nodes.desc: Public retrieve() wraps the subclass _retrieve with callback and recursion handling.

nodes.label: VectorIndexRetriever
nodes.desc: The retriever behind every VectorStoreIndex; embeds the query if the store needs it.

nodes.label: _retrieve
nodes.desc: Builds the VectorStoreQuery, calls the store, and re-ranks results into NodeWithScore.

nodes.label: _build_vector_store_query
nodes.desc: Fills query_embedding, top_k, doc/node id filters and mode into the query object.

nodes.label: RetrieverQueryEngine
nodes.desc: Query engine = retriever + node postprocessors + response synthesizer.

nodes.label: _query
nodes.desc: Runs retrieve() then hands the NodeWithScore list to the synthesizer.

nodes.label: get_response_synthesizer
nodes.desc: Maps a ResponseMode to a concrete synthesizer, defaulting llm and callbacks from Settings.

nodes.label: ResponseMode
nodes.desc: Strategy enum: REFINE, COMPACT, TREE_SUMMARIZE, SIMPLE_SUMMARIZE and friends.

nodes.label: BaseSynthesizer
nodes.desc: Owns the prompt templates, streaming flag and callback manager; synthesize() builds the prompt.

nodes.label: CompactAndRefine
nodes.desc: Packs retrieved chunks to fill each LLM call before refining, cutting token waste.

nodes.label: TreeSummarize
nodes.desc: Merges chunks in batches into partial summaries until one root answer remains.

nodes.label: CallbackManager
nodes.desc: Fan-out hub for handlers; start_trace/on_event_start build a nested trace map.

nodes.label: Settings
nodes.desc: Global singleton wiring: llm, embed_model, node_parser and callback_manager defaults.
